shots.start_state: Medium close-up of the model against a high-contrast fireground
shots.action: The model turns her chin slowly toward the lens with a cool, confident look; orange firelight slides across the patent coat while smoke passes behind
shots.end_state: Front/quarter close-up established, ready for a white-flash cut
shots.sound_cues: Low fire roar and crackle; coat rustle; no speech

shots.start_state: After the white-flash cut from the opening portrait
shots.action: The model walks left to right through black smoke in front of an orange flame bank; white-gold hair streams, coat flares, and firelight sweeps across the patent surface
shots.end_state: The stride is mid-frame as the shot moves to a face beat
shots.sound_cues: Heeled footsteps, fire crackle, moving smoke and fabric motion

shots.start_state: After a VHS-tear and white-flash cut from the profile stride
shots.action: The shot becomes a three-quarter close-up of the face; the narrow retro sunglasses catch twin orange fire reflections while the model stares calmly through flame-lit smoke
shots.end_state: Close face beat completed with the confident expression intact
shots.sound_cues: Low fire pop and faint hair/fabric rustle

shots.start_state: After a white-flash cut from the face close-up
shots.action: Full-length shot shows the model walking toward the camera through drifting smoke and embers; coat, white-gold hair, and high-heeled boots remain visible as firelight ripples across the patent leather
shots.end_state: The model is centered in the frame with smoke passing around her
shots.sound_cues: Approaching footsteps; steady fire crackle and air movement

shots.start_state: After a short glitch cut from the full-length approach
shots.action: Medium detail shot follows one hand as it drags over the high-gloss lapel; orange reflections travel across the patent surface, and the model lifts her chin slightly above the collar
shots.end_state: Lapel detail and glossy surface are clearly presented
shots.sound_cues: Soft coat rustle follows the hand; fire continues underneath

shots.start_state: After the frame breaks from material detail into CCTV-style dropout
shots.action: Rolling static, scanlines, and noise swallow the image; a white uppercase on-screen text reads "BROADCAST: INTERRUPTION" for a beat, then the signal re-locks on the model in the same firelit space
shots.end_state: The model reappears in a face-and-shoulders medium shot, unchanged in identity
shots.sound_cues: Electronic interference whine, static burst, then fire roar returns

shots.start_state: After a white-bloom cut from the re-locked CCTV frame
shots.action: Wide fireground composition shows the full model facing the camera with chin high, black smoke crossing between her and the flame walls; warm firelight continues to play across the patent coat
shots.end_state: Final pose is fully visible as a white bloom cuts to grain at 15 seconds
shots.sound_cues: Night fire roar and crackle until the final white bloom stops the sound
